correctness.reason: The graph-summary probe emitted StackRegionSegmentPlan rows, normal no-bridge execution succeeds, and reference-first bridge sanity plus one bridge forward can complete. Repeated bridge execution for the 24-block vitl stack hit Windows stack overflow -1073741571 before the depth guard. The guard now blocks this unproven deep bridge row before native execution and emits a StackOutputBridgeDeepSplitPlan.v0 payload with two 12-block chunks and a private-baton requirement.

entries.decision: Keep as historical unsafe evidence for the context-owned 24-block bridge topology. Do not rerun this path to rediscover the stack overflow; use the native private-baton deep-split canary evidence instead.
revisit_conditions: Only revisit the context-owned 24-block bridge topology if stack execution ownership changes enough to remove the original process-level stack overflow cause.
Keep vitl out of accepted StackRegionSegmentPlan rowsets until separate segment-plan correctness and process stability are proven.
Do not infer this historical unsafe topology from the native deep-split canary.

entries.head: post_a44414fb7db_deep_split_probe
entries.device_notes: RX 9070 evidence. This was a benchmark-local proof canary for the generic deep stack-output bridge split topology, not a production route.
entries.candidate: Split the 24-block stack-output bridge into two <=12-block Python-mediated chunks, use the last output of chunk 0 as a private baton, and feed the four captured Vulkan tensors through the existing LayerNorm and decoder-preprocess ops.

correctness.reason: The attempted Python private-baton canary still hit native Windows stack overflow -1073741571 at run_vision_backbone_stack_private_capture_debug before a result artifact could be written. The benchmark now treats PYTORCH_VULKAN_STACK_OUTPUT_BRIDGE_DEEP_SPLIT=python_private_baton as unsafe-blocked metadata and fails closed before entering native bridge execution.

entries.decision: Do not use a Python-mediated deep split bridge as the runtime proof path. Keep it cataloged as unsafe-blocked so future work moves to a real backend-owned StackOutputBridgeDeepSplitPlanRuntime.v0 or a lower-level stack execution ownership fix rather than rerunning this canary.
revisit_conditions: Only revisit if run_vision_backbone_stack_private_capture_debug stack usage is fixed independently and a one-repeat plus repeated vitl_140 canary writes valid result artifacts.
A future runtime proof should avoid Python-mediated public boundaries and implement private baton handoff inside backend-owned stack execution.
Keep the depth guard fail-closed for block_count > 12 until repeated deep-stack bridge correctness and process stability are proven.

entries.decision: Do not continue graph/transition diagnostics for the RX 9070 versus RX 6700 XT vitb_140 gap. The timestamped gap is dominated by buffer conv kernel families: RX 9070 is about 57.9 ms slower than RX 6700 XT in conv2d_buffer_float_3x3_s1p1 and about 55.9 ms slower in generic conv2d_buffer_float. The accepted next step is reporting-only VulkanConvPlanKey.v0 rows with selected kernel, contract provenance, layout, workgroup, and tunability fields. Fused conv-add submissions are also covered so the s1p1 bottleneck can be tuned as a complete family; no candidate tuning or default promotion is claimed here.
revisit_conditions: When adding a candidate-plan cache for buffer conv families.
